name: Budget
description: Monthly envelope budgets: planned vs spent vs left per top-level expense category (converted to the default currency), a month summary, a compact 13-month cashflow strip and a detail with subcategories and transactions, using paid transactions only.
keyActions: see planned, spent and left per envelope for a month
set a monthly plan on an envelope
open an envelope to see subcategories and transactions
view the compact monthly cashflow strip
